All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Status
The three stages a task can occupy.
Task
An immutable task.
TaskBoard
Main workspace with status counts, a text search and the list of matching tasks.
TaskDialog
Modal task editor and deletion confirmation.
TaskFlow
Starts the TaskFlow desktop application and keeps its workspace open until the window closes.
TaskManager
Maintains tasks in creation order and applies changes using stable identifiers.
TaskStore
Stores one workspace as UTF-8 properties and locks it for the editing session.
TaskTable
A read-only table that displays titles, notes previews and labelled status badges.
Theme
Shared colors, type and controls for the workspace and its dialogs.
